reviews.title: Works great - cooling design could be better
reviews.comment:
This is an excellent graphics card.  It does everything you’d expect.  Probably the only negatives I’d give it is to do with cooling.
The fan intake will be 1/4 of an inch of any adjacent card.  Seems like they could channel in air from the side.  And then there’s the insistence on exhausting the hot air inside the case.  The card takes up 3 slots!  There’s a huge amount of space on the back to exhaust most of the hot air.  But no, they dump it inside the case.
It’s not as if the founders edition cards don’t show how to do it properly.  For 1 card, this is not ideal but workable.  For 2 it really isn’t.  You’d have to go water cooling.  The amount of heat one card gives off is immense.  300w.  Make sure you have significant ventilation even for the 1 card.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Excellent value, and practically brand new.
reviews.comment:
Was coming from a 9070 XT that I just really tried to accept and use, but the constant issues just became too much. I went back to NVIDIA because I just wanted something that worked right out of the box.
I was a bit hesitant at buying a renewed card at first, but you could tell this was treated with incredible care, and meticulous attention to detail. The only difference from this and a brand new one is the box at this point, I mean all the port plugs were in place, plastic was wrapped with precision, and the card’s shroud was spotless in general, with no visible defects or anything of the sort. It runs fantastic on my PC, and the fans aren’t too loud from what I’ve seen so far. This is the closest you’ll get to a 5070 TI at MSRP, I would grab it before they’re gone!
reviews.author: Eddie

reviews.title: Works like it should
reviews.comment: I was a bit leery buying renewed but I am happy to say everything works, I stressed tested it and everything is working to spec. I have played a few games on it and combined with a ultra wide screen I am loving the fps and fov.

reviews.title: Great deal on a great GPU
reviews.comment: GPU works great! Package arrived a day early and the GPU was wrapped in antistatic wrap and encased in polyethylne foam in a form fitted boxed which was in a larger box cushioned with packaging paper. The Pcie connector and DP and HDMI ports were all protected as well. Excellent attention to detail with the packaging and for $130 less than new this was a great refurbished deal.
